orkas-ai-orkas-videostudio-composition-d.description: Design review layer for OrkasVideoStudio COMPOSE previews and drafts. Review the complete snapshot index and inspect the cover and risky frames at full size before showing a visual preview. Return one complete, actionable repair set without opening another user gate.

orkas-ai-orkas-videostudio-design-system.description: Turns reference images, videos, screenshots and brand guides into concrete visual and timing constraints (reproduce, edit or guide).

orkas-ai-orkas-videostudio-frontend-desi.description: Visual direction for page-rendered video: design presets, type, palette, layout and motion. Read as needed before writing index.html.

orkas-ai-orkas-videostudio-gate-control.description: Resolve review gates for an explicitly requested legacy plan workflow.

orkas-ai-orkas-videostudio-orchestration.description: Compatibility entry for multi-source production; use video-studio for current work.

orkas-ai-orkas-videostudio-stage-assembl.description: Assemble legacy EDL parts or a current mixed-source video.

orkas-ai-orkas-videostudio-stage-compose.description: Author scene-based HTML video with declarative HyperFrames timing; retain legacy v2 composition APIs for existing projects.

orkas-ai-orkas-videostudio-stage-consist.description: Keep recurring characters, props and shot geography consistent across generated shots.

orkas-ai-orkas-videostudio-stage-decide.description: EDIT with content judgment: pick highlights, remove dead air or fillers, shorten recordings into a reviewable rough cut.

orkas-ai-orkas-videostudio-stage-edit.description: Work on real footage with ffmpeg: trim, join, reframe, mix, burn subtitles, overlay, extract frames.

orkas-ai-orkas-videostudio-stage-generat.description: Produce authorized native image/video shots while preserving references, settings and completed outputs.

orkas-ai-orkas-videostudio-stage-plan.description: Maintain an existing legacy EDL or prepare a user-requested plan.

orkas-ai-orkas-videostudio-video-craft.description: What makes a video good: hooks, pacing, hierarchy, type, motion, captions, audio, platform norms and a pre-publish check.

orkas-ai-orkas-videostudio-video-router.description: Compatibility entry for earlier skill installations. Start new work with video-studio.

orkas-ai-orkas-videostudio-video-studio.description: Make a whole video from one request: gather material, produce, check and deliver. Read first for a new video or script request.
